title: Nested dataclass schema must enumerate fields via dataclasses.fields(), not __annotations__
answers: nested dataclass model signature rejects inherited field like role
valid message input fails schema validation when dataclass subclass inherits fields
MLflow signature nested dataclass missing parent class fields
ClassVar or InitVar showing up as a required input in nested dataclass schema
body:
Symptom: A nested dataclass input (e.g. a chat message with an inherited `role`) is rejected by schema validation, even though the value is valid; fields defined on a parent dataclass are missing from the inferred schema.
Root cause: mlflow/types/schema.py:_convert_dataclass_to_nested_object iterated `dataclass.__annotations__`, which holds only the class's own annotations (no inherited fields) and also includes pseudo-fields (ClassVar, InitVar, KW_ONLY sentinel).
Fix pattern: Build nested object properties from `dataclasses.fields(dataclass)`, passing `field.name` and `field.type` to `_convert_field_to_property`. `fields()` returns the MRO-merged real fields and skips pseudo-fields.
Constraints: Any code that derives per-field schema from a dataclass in this module must use `fields()`, not `__annotations__` or `__dict__`. Regression tests for this live in tests/types/test_schema.py (nested inheritance, inherited-only subclass, override, pseudo-fields, diamond inheritance). Field types are taken as written; `field.type` may be a string under postponed annotations, so do not assume it is resolved.
applies: Nested dataclass conversion to Object/ColSpec types in mlflow/types/schema.py; applies to any future change to dataclass-to-schema conversion.
says: Valid chat messages are rejected by model input schema validation because of inherited fields.
The model signature validation fails on inputs that inherit properties from a base class.
Internal class variables are incorrectly required as model input fields during validation.
Allow structured model inputs to include inherited attributes without failing schema checks.
search: In mlflow/types/schema.py:_convert_dataclass_to_nested_object, nested dataclass properties must be obtained via dataclasses.fields(dataclass) and passed to _convert_field_to_property. Using __annotations__ misses MRO-inherited fields and includes pseudo-fields like ClassVar, InitVar, and KW_ONLY. Applies to Object and ColSpec conversion in schema.py, where field.type can be a string under postponed annotations and must not be assumed resolved.
